description.value: Chez Joe Poutine is a French-Canadian inspired poutine restaurant in Sun Peaks, BC, opened in 2017 by Suzanne, a Quebec transplant who set out to recreate authentic Quebecois poutine on the west coast. The menu spans classic and specialty poutines, grill items (burgers, smokies, hot dogs, chicken tenders), and ice cream, with an unusually inclusive range of gluten-free, vegan, and vegetarian adaptations. For a touring cyclist arriving at Sun Peaks, it offers a calorie-dense, customizable hot meal in a casual counter-service setting.
